articles.title: Trump makes fevered campaign push in final weekend before election
articles.description: The US president rallied in states that Republicans previously won - showcasing how tight Tuesday's elections could be in determining control of Congress.

articles.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
articles.description: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.

articles.title: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
articles.description: The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year's deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival.

articles.title: India's opposition holds mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
articles.description: Thousands gathered in the heart of delhi, calling for the chief election commissioner to step down.

articles.title: Judge orders Trump administration to stop threatening US election officials
articles.description: The order comes after election officials received letters demanding they set aside the ballots of possible non-citizen voters.

articles.title: Ethiopian PM puts ministers through military training
articles.description: The prime minister has previously emphasised military preparedness as central to his government's ambitions.

articles.title: Spain train disaster clouds Sánchez chances of re-election
articles.description: The Spanish PM is hit by a succession of crises just weeks before a snap general election.

articles.title: Man dies and another injured after attack at centre housing migrants
articles.description: A man has died following an attack at a centre housing migrants in Ireland.
